_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#13. The half of the claim an agent can check in a 4C log is upstream of the critical-stretch formula: the same CRITICAL_STRETCH and the same horizon under Peridynamic_2DPlaneStrain and Peridynamic_2DPlaneStress are two different constitutive problems, because the bond micromodulus normalisation differs (5/(pi*delta^3) vs 6/(pi*delta^3) in the 4C source). Flipping only that enum on upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml initialises the identical 1512 bonds — so nothing geometric betrays it and no count differs — emits no warning of any kind, and still breaks eight of the deck's ten result tests. The enum is silent and the only evidence is the answer. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
